description: Lists the avatars the user created or got on Ania, with thumbnail and status. Use for "my avatars", "the avatar I made", or before opening one of theirs. For the public catalogue use search_avatars or search_marketplace; for purchases use my_purchases.

language.description: Always pass it: the language the user is writing in right now, as a BCP-47 tag (e.g. 'en', 'en-US', 'pt-BR', 'es'), not the app's interface language. Replies, prices and the card follow it.
